attendance_policy: Attendance is compulsory as per the Institute policy, regularity in theory and practical classes will be decisive factor during make-up and grading, especially in borderline cases as well as make-up's.
makeup_policy: Generally, make-up will be considered for regular students only and make-up's are not given as a routine. It is solely dependent on the 'genuineness' of the circumstance under which a student fails to appear in a scheduled evaluation component. However, the make-up application should be personally given to Instructor-in-Charge and not slipped into the chamber of the Instructor-in-Charge.
